title: Clinicopathological characteristics and cyclosporine-responsive proteinuria in nail-patella syndrome with a novel LMX1B mutation.
authors: Jiang, Lanping; Feng, Shaozhen; Xu, Ziqi; Chen, Yingqian; Chen, Wenfang; Zheng, Xunhua; Chen, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究NPS肾病中LMX1B突变对靶基因转录调控的影响及环孢素疗效，虽涉及TF-DNA结合（LMX1B与启动子）和分子动力学分析，但核心是临床病例与湿实验验证，互作机制与AI/物理模拟方法深度不足。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Nephropathy in nail-patella syndrome (NPS) has limited therapeutic options. Progressive nephrotic-range proteinuria often persists despite maximal renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system inhibitor (RAASi) therapy. Calcineurin inhibitors such as cyclosporine A (CsA) are unexplored in NPS. We therefore evaluated the efficacy and safety of CsA in a patient with NPS. METHODS: A 15-year-old boy with genetically confirmed NPS (novel LMX1B missense variant, c.796T>G, p. W266G) was studied. Clinical, pathological, and follow-up data were analyzed. Bioinformatic screening (GSE12008 dataset) identified LMX1B-regulated podocyte genes. Functional assays (immunofluorescence, dual luciferase reporter, and molecular dynamics analyses) assessed the mutation's impact. RESULTS: The patient presented with classical NPS features, including nail dysplasia, limited elbow motion, patellar dysplasia, and proteinuria. Kidney biopsy revealed focal glomeruli immaturity with small foci of foamy cells, diffuse foot process effacement, and heterogeneous glomerular basement membrane (GBM) abnormalities (predominantly thinned with segmental thickening and loosening), demonstrating Alport-like kidney pathology. Despite resistance to RAASi and sodium-glucose cotransporter inhibitor (SGLT2i), CsA therapy for 7 months significantly reduced proteinuria from 3.74 to 0.697 g/24 h, increased serum albumin from 28.8 to 39.4 g/L, and maintained normal serum creatinine (54-63 mumol/L). Immunofluorescence analysis of the patient's kidney tissue indicated reduced expressions of PTPRO, NPHS2, and COL4A3. The W266G mutation severely impaired LMX1B binding to the promoters, reducing the transcriptional activity of PTPRO, NPHS2, and COL4A3. CONCLUSIONS: CsA effectively reduced nephrotic-range proteinuria in genetically confirmed NPS, suggesting the therapeutic potential of calcineurin inhibitors in for NPS-associated nephropathy.
abstract_zh: 背景：指甲-髌骨综合征（NPS）相关肾病的治疗选择有限。尽管采用最大剂量的肾素-血管紧张素-醛固酮系统抑制剂（RAASi）治疗，进行性肾病范围蛋白尿仍常持续存在。钙调神经磷酸酶抑制剂如环孢素A（CsA）在NPS中尚未被探索。因此，我们评估了CsA在一例NPS患者中的疗效和安全性。方法：研究了一名经基因确诊为NPS的15岁男孩（新型LMX1B错义变异，c.796T>G，p. W266G）。分析了临床、病理和随访数据。生物信息学筛选（GSE12008数据集）识别出LMX1B调控的足细胞基因。功能实验（免疫荧光、双荧光素酶报告基因和分子动力学分析）评估了该突变的影响。结果：该患者表现出典型的NPS特征，包括指甲发育不良、肘关节活动受限、髌骨发育不良和蛋白尿。肾活检显示局灶性肾小球不成熟，伴小灶泡沫细胞，弥漫性足突融合，以及异质性肾小球基底膜（GBM）异常（以变薄为主，伴节段性增厚和疏松），呈现Alport样肾脏病理。尽管对RAASi和钠-葡萄糖共转运蛋白抑制剂（SGLT2i）耐药，CsA治疗7个月显著将蛋白尿从3.74 g/24 h降至0.697 g/24 h，血清白蛋白从28.8 g/L升至39.4 g/L，并维持血清肌酐正常（54-63 μmol/L）。患者肾组织的免疫荧光分析显示PTPRO、NPHS2和COL4A3表达降低。W266G突变严重损害了LMX1B与启动子的结合，降低了PTPRO、NPHS2和COL4A3的转录活性。结论：CsA有效减少了基因确诊NPS患者的肾病范围蛋白尿，提示钙调神经磷酸酶抑制剂在NPS相关肾病中具有治疗潜力。
